facts.fact: Al-Watwan reports that the Comoros interior minister said GenKey took over production of biometric passports and national identity cards on 31 March 2026 from Semlex, with a transfer of skills to national staff and progressive national appropriation of biometric data.
facts.system: Comoros biometric document production (passports and national identity cards)

facts.fact: Al-Watwan reports that GenKey took over production of Comorian biometric documents, passports and national identity cards, on 31 March 2026 after Semlex held the concession from 2007.
facts.system: Comoros biometric document production (passports and national identity cards)
